Coalescing lesions causing complete 'burning' or blighting of massive leaf areas

Large, grayish-green to tan cigar-shaped spots (Northern)

Exserohilum turcicum (fungal pathogen causing Northern Corn Leaf Blight)

farmerFriendlyExplanation: Fungal infections that create large, cigar-shaped or diamond-shaped dead spots on the leaves.
